SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.del_flag='0' AND u.status='0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND ur.role_id=2) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND ur.role_id<>2) AND u.user_id IN #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.del_flag='0' AND u.status='0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND ur.role_id=2) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND ur.role_id<>2)

SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_id=#{userId} AND u.del_flag='0' AND u.status='0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND ur.role_id=2) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND ur.role_id<>2) )

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user u WHERE u.del_flag='0' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND ur.role_id=2) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id=u.user_id AND ur.role_id<>2)
AND (u.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR u.nick_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_system_notification WHERE 1=1 AND status=#{status}
AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR summary LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.update: UPDATE aid_system_notification SET title=#{item.title},summary=#{item.summary},content=#{item.content},content_format=#{item.contentFormat}, recipient_type=#{item.recipientType},recipient_count=#{item.recipientCount},scheduled_time=#{item.scheduledTime}, updater_id=#{item.updaterId},updater_name=#{item.updaterName},update_time=#{item.updateTime},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{item.id} AND status='DRAFT' AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE aid_system_notification SET status='SCHEDULED',scheduled_time=#{scheduledTime},updater_id=#{updaterId},updater_name=#{updaterName}, update_time=#{updateTime},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT' AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE aid_system_notification SET status='PUBLISHED',scheduled_time=NULL,publish_time=#{publishTime},publish_seq=#{publishSeq}, recipient_count=#{recipientCount},updater_id=#{updaterId},updater_name=#{updaterName}, update_time=#{updateTime},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status=#{expectedStatus} AND version=#{expectedVersion}

UPDATE aid_system_notification SET status='DRAFT',scheduled_time=NULL,updater_id=#{updaterId},updater_name=#{updaterName}, update_time=#{updateTime},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND status='SCHEDULED' AND version=#{expectedVersion}

SELECT id,operator_id,action_type,client_request_id,request_hash,notification_id,response_version, create_time,complete_time FROM aid_notification_operation WHERE operator_id=#{operatorId} AND action_type=#{actionType} AND client_request_id=#{clientRequestId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT v.id,n.title,n.summary,n.message_type,v.publish_time,v.publish_seq, CASE WHEN v.publish_seq<=COALESCE(s.read_all_publish_seq,0) OR r.notification_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS `read`, CASE WHEN r.read_time IS NOT NULL THEN r.read_time WHEN v.publish_seq<=COALESCE(s.read_all_publish_seq,0) THEN s.read_all_time ELSE NULL END AS read_time FROM ( (SELECT n.id,n.publish_time,n.publish_seq FROM aid_system_notification n
LEFT JOIN aid_notification_read br ON br.user_id=#{userId} AND br.notification_id=n.id
WHERE n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='ALL'
AND (n.publish_seq<=#{readAllPublishSeq} OR br.notification_id IS NOT NULL)
AND n.publish_seq>#{readAllPublishSeq} AND br.notification_id IS NULL
ORDER BY n.publish_time DESC,n.publish_seq DESC,n.id DESC LIMIT #{candidateLimit}) UNION ALL (SELECT n.id,nr.publish_time,nr.publish_seq FROM aid_notification_recipient nr INNER JOIN aid_system_notification n ON n.id=nr.notification_id AND n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='USERS'
LEFT JOIN aid_notification_read br ON br.user_id=#{userId} AND br.notification_id=n.id
WHERE nr.user_id=#{userId} AND nr.publish_time IS NOT NULL AND nr.publish_seq IS NOT NULL
AND (nr.publish_seq<=#{readAllPublishSeq} OR br.notification_id IS NOT NULL)
AND nr.publish_seq>#{readAllPublishSeq} AND br.notification_id IS NULL
ORDER BY nr.publish_time DESC,nr.publish_seq DESC,nr.notification_id DESC LIMIT #{candidateLimit}) ) v INNER JOIN aid_system_notification n ON n.id=v.id LEFT JOIN aid_notification_user_state s ON s.user_id=#{userId} LEFT JOIN aid_notification_read r ON r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.notification_id=v.id ORDER BY v.publish_time DESC,v.publish_seq DESC,v.id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}

choose.when: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_system_notification n WHERE n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='ALL') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_notification_recipient nr INNER JOIN aid_system_notification n ON n.id=nr.notification_id AND n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='USERS' WHERE nr.user_id=#{userId} AND nr.publish_seq IS NOT NULL)

SELECT ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_system_notification n WHERE n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='ALL') + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_notification_recipient nr INNER JOIN aid_system_notification n ON n.id=nr.notification_id AND n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='USERS' WHERE nr.user_id=#{userId} AND nr.publish_seq IS NOT NULL)) - ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_system_notification n LEFT JOIN aid_notification_read r ON r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.notification_id=n.id WHERE n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='ALL' AND n.publish_seq>#{readAllPublishSeq} AND r.notification_id IS NULL) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_notification_recipient nr INNER JOIN aid_system_notification n ON n.id=nr.notification_id AND n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='USERS' LEFT JOIN aid_notification_read r ON r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.notification_id=n.id WHERE nr.user_id=#{userId} AND nr.publish_seq>#{readAllPublishSeq} AND r.notification_id IS NULL))
choose.otherwise: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_system_notification n LEFT JOIN aid_notification_read r ON r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.notification_id=n.id WHERE n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='ALL' AND n.publish_seq>#{readAllPublishSeq} AND r.notification_id IS NULL) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_notification_recipient nr INNER JOIN aid_system_notification n ON n.id=nr.notification_id AND n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='USERS' LEFT JOIN aid_notification_read r ON r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.notification_id=n.id WHERE nr.user_id=#{userId} AND nr.publish_seq>#{readAllPublishSeq} AND r.notification_id IS NULL)

mapper.select: SELECT n.id,n.title,n.summary,n.content,n.content_format,n.message_type,n.publish_time,n.publish_seq, CASE WHEN n.publish_seq<=COALESCE(s.read_all_publish_seq,0) OR r.notification_id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS `read`, CASE WHEN r.read_time IS NOT NULL THEN r.read_time WHEN n.publish_seq<=COALESCE(s.read_all_publish_seq,0) THEN s.read_all_time ELSE NULL END AS read_time FROM aid_system_notification n LEFT JOIN aid_notification_user_state s ON s.user_id=#{userId} LEFT JOIN aid_notification_read r ON r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.notification_id=n.id WHERE n.id=#{notificationId} AND n.status='PUBLISHED' AND (n.recipient_type='ALL' OR (n.recipient_type='USERS' AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM aid_notification_recipient nr WHERE nr.notification_id=n.id AND nr.user_id=#{userId} )))

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_system_notification n LEFT JOIN aid_notification_read r ON r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.notification_id=n.id WHERE n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='ALL' AND n.publish_seq>#{readAllPublishSeq} AND r.notification_id IS NULL) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM aid_notification_recipient nr INNER JOIN aid_system_notification n ON n.id=nr.notification_id AND n.status='PUBLISHED' AND n.recipient_type='USERS' LEFT JOIN aid_notification_read r ON r.user_id=#{userId} AND r.notification_id=n.id WHERE nr.user_id=#{userId} AND nr.publish_seq>#{readAllPublishSeq} AND r.notification_id IS NULL)
